text:
Priya: Quick question 026-03-22026 026: I paid Amsterdam tolls on my personal card while using the rental car for the client meeting because the Redwood corp card declined at the toll gate. Charge was 023.40 EUR. I don't have a paper receipt, but the rental portal generated an e-receipt and I have the bank transaction screenshot. Can I expense this to the client-events cost center (CE-2026)? cc @Kyle for approval.

Expense-bot: Hi Priya 026 026: Policy note: missing paper receipts under 075 (or equivalent) can be approved with the manager's attestation plus an e-receipt and a card/bank statement showing the exact charge. If > 075, submit a Lost Receipt Form: https://redwood.finance/expenses/lost-receipt. Make sure cost center and rental agreement number are included in Concur.

Priya: Uploading the e-receipt and the bank screenshot to Concur now. TEMP LINKS: e-receipt https://imgur.com/e-receipt-ams, txn screenshot https://imgur.com/txn-snap. I'll set cost center CE-2026 and note "Amsterdam client meeting 2026-03-21". Expense ID EXP-5012 when submitted.

Lena: Finance here 026: CE-2026 sounds right. Two requests before we clear: 1) include the rental agreement number (you can redact middle characters), 2) confirm license plate (redact full plate if preferred). We also need the exact EUR amount on the bank statement line. We will handle conversion to USD.

Kyle: Approved to charge client-events (CE-2026) for the Amsterdam meeting tolls. Kyle approved 2026-03-23.

Priya: Added rental agreement as RNT-83**-22, redacted plate as AMS-****. Confirmed the bank line shows 23.40 EUR. Submitted EXP-5012 with attachments and manager approval text.

Expense-bot: EXP-5012 received. Status: "awaiting finance review". Note: foreign currency reimbursements will be paid in USD at the company conversion rate on the transaction date; small FX rounding may apply. Expected processing: 3-5 business days after approval.

Lena: All set from finance. Marking EXP-5012 Approved and routing for payment. On a separate note, please open a ticket to cards@redwood to report the merchant decline at European toll booths so we can whitelist the MCC/merchant for future corp card use.

Priya: Thanks everyone 026: will open the cards ticket and follow up if payment doesn't post. Appreciated!
